title: Flights per month
statementMd:
Number of flights departing each month (YYYY-MM), earliest first.

Expected columns: `month`, `flights`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', depart_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS flights FROM flights GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
